review_method: Opened every page PNG at original detail with view_image; inspected 120 dpi raster pages visually in batches of four or five. This review applies to qa-final images available during this pass.
overall: No clipping, overlap, table overflow, broken Vietnamese glyphs, blank pages or orphaned figure captions found. Red figure guidance is readable and remains in the intended section. The previously reported missing list separators, narrow TC identifier column and H18 capture-instruction split have been corrected. One minor punctuation issue remains in capture-step joins.

errors.description: The capture_steps array items end in a full stop, but the renderer also joins them with '; ', producing '.;' between sentences. Examples on page 32 include 'Infrastructure.; Ghi trách nhiệm' and 'thành phần.; Phân biệt'. This does not cause visual clipping but should be cleaned up for polished guidance.
errors.suggested_fix: Join capture_steps with a single space because each item is already a complete sentence. Continue joining must_show and hide with '; '.

resolved_previous_findings.description: must_show and hide requirements now have visible semicolon separators.
The TC column is wider; TC01–TC25 appear intact on single lines. Table text stays within margins.
H18, H19 and H20 each keep their capture-step paragraph, placeholder, caption and analysis together. H18 no longer starts with its capture instructions split across pages.

observations.description: Remaining lower-page whitespace follows chapter conclusions and precedes chapter breaks; these pages contain meaningful content and are not blank.
Hình 4.1 is intact and legible with Vietnamese glyphs rendered correctly, margin-safe diagram bounds and caption directly below.
Borders and text are clear; repeated headers remain with actual data rows on continuation pages. No detached table header or column-width overflow was found.
Figure guidance H04–H20 is next to the corresponding section. Figure placeholders and captions remain together, and the red text has adequate contrast and readable size.
